sv.title: Omrörare (HRW)
sv.description: Häny HRW används som mellanlager mellan blandaren och pumpen. I den långsamt roterande omröraren homogeniseras injekteringsmassan och eventuella luftbubblor avlägsnas.

blocks.html: Häny HRW används som mellanlager mellan blandaren och pumpen. I den långsamt roterande omröraren homogeniseras injekteringsmassan och eventuella luftbubblor avlägsnas.

Mellantank mellan blandare och injekteringspump

en.title: Agitators (HRW)
en.description: The Häny HRW agitators are used as holding tanks between the HCM mixer and the pump. In the slowly revolving agitator the grout suspension is homogenised and air bubbles are removed.

blocks.html: The Häny HRW agitators are used as holding tanks between the HCM mixer and the pump. In the slowly revolving agitator the grout suspension is homogenised and air bubbles are removed.

items: Slowly rotating paddle for homogenization of the mixed material and removal of existing air bubbles
Cleaning opening with protective grid and splash guard
Inclined bottom for complete emptying with drain plug
Holding tank between mixer and injection pump

right.html: Agitators ensure continuous operation by holding and homogenizing the mixed suspension and removing any air bubbles by means of a slowly rotating paddle.

items: Slowly rotating paddle for homogenization of the mixed material and removal of existing air bubbles
Cleaning opening with protective grid and splash guard
Inclined bottom for complete emptying with drain plug
Holding tank between mixer and injection pump

right.html: Agitators ensure continuous operation by holding and homogenizing the mixed suspension and removing any air bubbles by means of a slowly rotating paddle. Optional level sensors enable fully automatic operation.

items: Complete circulation of the tank contents by means of an agitator shaft arranged angled to the tank with mixing paddle (no hard-to-clean static paddles)
Slowly rotating paddle for homogenization of the mixed material and removal of existing air bubbles
Cleaning opening with safety switch
Central hitching point for easy transportation
Optional level sensors for consumption-dependent and fully automatic operation
Holding tank between mixer and injection pump
Optional (Agitator): Level sensors 1", "full - empty"
Optional (Agitator): Flange connection with butterfly valve 2½"

es.title: Agitadores (HRW)
es.description: Los agitadores Häny HRW se utilizan como depósito intermedio entre la mezcladora HCM y la bomba. En el agitador, de giro lento, la suspensión se homogeneiza y se eliminan las burbujas de aire.

blocks.html: Los agitadores Häny HRW se utilizan como depósito intermedio entre la mezcladora HCM y la bomba. En el agitador, de giro lento, la suspensión se homogeneiza y se eliminan las burbujas de aire.

items: Paleta de giro lento para homogeneizar el material mezclado y eliminar las burbujas de aire
Abertura de limpieza con rejilla de protección y protector contra salpicaduras
Fondo inclinado para el vaciado completo con tapón de vaciado
Depósito intermedio entre la mezcladora y la bomba de inyección
